source_title: Solved Sudden Drop In Etsy Sales And No Search Visibility 6 9Th November 2025

snippets.snippet_text: "On the 6th of November, our sales went from 1.2k per day, to £20 -Etsy support were no help, stating it was just our SEO. It was clear that it wasn't, as we just weren't visible in search. Our shop name wasn't coming up, nada."
